name: fetch-web
title: Web Fetch & Synthesis Pipeline
description: Deterministic web fetching pipeline with LLM synthesis. RAG-first: checks local cache before fetching. Tools handle HTTP, LLM handles analysis.
author: SolSolis-Sys

inputs.name: urls
inputs.description: Comma-separated list of URLs to fetch (max 5). Example: https://example.com/page1,https://example.com/page2

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Research question to answer from fetched content. Guides synthesis and RAG search.

inputs.name: rag_dir
inputs.description: Local RAG cache directory to check first. Path relative to conductor workspace.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.description: Output format: markdown (default), json, or summary

inputs.name: max_urls
inputs.description: Maximum URLs to fetch in one run. Safety limit.

agents.command: for file in $(find {{rag_dir}} -type f \( -name '*.txt' -o -name '*.md' \) 2>/dev/null | head -10); do echo "=== $file ==="  && head -100 "$file"; done

urls="{{urls}}"; count=0; for url in ${urls//,/ }; do if [ $count -ge {{max_urls}} ]; then break; fi; echo "=== Fetching: $url ==="; curl -s -L --max-time 15 --user-agent 'conductor-fetch-web/1.0' "$url" | head -2000 || echo "FETCH_ERROR: Failed to fetch $url"; count=$((count+1)); done

agents.prompt:
Research Question: {{query}}

Available Source Material:

RAG Cache Snippets (if found):
{{rag_content}}

Freshly Fetched Content:
{{fetched_content}}

Your task:
1. Synthesize all available sources (RAG + fetched) to answer the research question
2. Cite sources by URL or filename
3. Highlight key findings and contradictions if any
4. Estimate confidence (low/medium/high)
5. Suggest next search terms if answer is incomplete

Format output as {{output_format}}:
- If 'markdown': use headers, lists, and code blocks
- If 'json': return {"answer": "", "sources": [], "confidence": "medium", "next_steps": []}
- If 'summary': 2-3 sentence summary only
